contract.task: TREC-COVID/licensed review and reminted open-world search: coverage, saturation, remote jumps, and premature stopping under equal budgets.
contract.claim_boundary: No finite study establishes global completeness; donor-equivalent, null, harmful, crashed, censored, and CANNOT_CHECK outcomes remain visible.

case_freeze.case_selection: all and only frozen topic ids 1 through 50; no topic may be dropped
case_freeze.chronology: single BEIR TREC-COVID world scored against its bound qrels; no cross-round comparison

information_and_leakage.qrels_load_order: all policy rankings and stop/route decisions are materialized and hashed before qrels/test.tsv is opened
information_and_leakage.document_id_use: stable deterministic tie break only, never a feature
pre_score_probes: scan corpus JSON keys for forbidden label-like fields
verify policy-ranking artifact exists and is hashed before qrels access
verify policies receive no qrels object or qrels path
verify no case is dropped after scoring

retrieval_and_policy_freeze.analyzer: lowercase Unicode alphanumeric token runs of length at least 2

policies.rule: equal-weight RRF of question, keyword, and narrative BM25 rankings; top 100
deduplicated round-robin over the three local BM25 rankings; top 100
when the frozen local-saturation predicate is true, return the first 60 LOCAL_MULTIFORM_RRF items and incorrectly declare task closure; otherwise return 100 and remain open
when local saturation is true, retain 60 LOCAL_MULTIFORM_RRF items and add 40 deterministic seed-20260825 corpus samples outside the local top 300; otherwise equal LOCAL_MULTIFORM_RRF

derive eight non-query bridge terms prospectively from the first 20 LOCAL_MULTIFORM_RRF documents, requiring presence in at least three feedback documents and corpus df <= 10 percent; rank the corpus by BM25 over question plus bridge terms; top 100

when local saturation is true and at least one admissible bridge term exists, retain 60 LOCAL_MULTIFORM_RRF items and add up to 40 ANALOGY_PRF items outside the local top 300, then fill from local ranks if needed; otherwise remain LOCAL_MULTIFORM_RRF and retain the unresolved obligation
equal-weight RRF over LOCAL_MULTIFORM_RRF, DIVERSIFIED_ROUND_ROBIN, and ANALOGY_PRF rankings; top 100; fixed before outcomes and not an oracle per-topic selector

local_saturation_predicate.definition: mean pairwise Jaccard across the three local top-100 sets is at least 0.20 and the final registered local form contributes at most 25 percent unique documents relative to the union of the first two forms

bridge_term_rule.score: sum over feedback documents of log(1 + N/(df+1)) * log(1+tf)
bridge_term_rule.exclude: all tokens occurring in any of the three registered query forms

material_donor_requirements.interpretation: The runnable product is an internal lexical and PRF donor envelope, not a substitute for an unavailable biomedical neural hybrid.

endpoint_freeze.primary_contrast: paired topic-level STRUCTURAL_JUMP minus IDEAL_DONOR_PRODUCT_RRF recall_at_100
endpoint_freeze.remote_contrast: paired topic-level STRUCTURAL_JUMP minus LOCAL_MULTIFORM_RRF recall_at_100 among prospectively licensed jump topics
endpoint_freeze.premature_closure_definition: a policy declares task closure before depth 100 and its own precomputed full ranking contains at least one qrels-relevant document between returned depth plus 1 and 100
endpoint_freeze.qrels_bounded_residual_fraction: one minus recall at returned depth; explicitly not an open-world completeness estimate
endpoint_freeze.unresolvedness_estimate: one minus size(union of local top-100 sets)/size(union of local top-300 sets), clipped to [0,1] and computed before qrels
endpoint_freeze.unresolvedness_observed_target: one minus recall at returned depth, bounded to the public qrels only

positive_requires: all eight hard preconditions required for full positive are attained
primary paired recall difference 95 percent lower bound greater than or equal to -0.02
remote paired recall difference on licensed jump topics has 95 percent lower bound greater than 0
STRUCTURAL_JUMP has no more premature task closures than every donor
terminal_rule.negative_donor_sufficient_when_full_enve: IDEAL_DONOR_PRODUCT_RRF weakly dominates STRUCTURAL_JUMP on every primary coordinate and is strictly better on at least one

resource_freeze.data_staging: copy the three bound files into job-local SNIC_TMP; never modify /home/scyiu/orion-work/ORION

output_schema.case_level_rows: 50 topics times 8 policies = 400 retained rows unless an input precondition prevents scoring, in which case zero rows plus the exact failed precondition

authority_ceiling.scientific_scope: Public TREC-COVID qrels-bounded internal comparison only; full P2 positive is unavailable while material donor, transfer worlds, and independent gold custody are unmet.
